title: Operator role, system, and residual-linearization contracts
purpose: Prevent the readable K/M/C/F and R/K_t layer from drifting away from executable UFL weak-form structure.

execution.evidence: Pure composition tests and a DOLFINx/UFL residual linearization test run in the release FEniCSx environment.

observables: Operator sums and scales retain operand provenance.
Matrix, vector, residual, and scalar roles agree with UFL argument count.
First-order systems expose C x_dot + K x = F and reject incompatible component roles.
UFL linearization produces a bilinear tangent recorded as K_t = dR/du.
acceptance: All operator contract tests pass without assembling a mislabeled weak form.
The residual has form arity one and its differentiated tangent has arity two.
Validation failures carry stable AFM-OP or AFM-SYS issue codes.
limitations: The benchmark does not yet verify mixed/block operator domain compatibility or unit algebra.
Numerical tangent quality for a constitutive model remains the responsibility of that model's own benchmark.
